MIME Type Lookup

Look up MIME types by file extension and extensions by MIME type — searchable reference of 100+ common types.

📖 How to use

  1. Type a file extension (e.g. webp) or MIME type (e.g. image/webp).
  2. The table filters instantly in both directions.
  3. Click a row's type to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a MIME type?

MIME types (media types) tell browsers and servers what kind of data a file contains, e.g. image/png or application/json.

Can I search in both directions?

Yes — type either a file extension or a MIME type; the search matches both directions.

How complete is the list?

The most common web, image, audio, video, document, font and archive types. Rare vendor types may be missing.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
